Community garden planning

Our main guide explains the planting calendar and describes the equipment used by volunteer teams throughout the growing season.

Soil preparation
Before the first planting day, loosen the soil and mix in mature compost so that water can reach the roots evenly across the garden.

Use a little more water if the soil is dry before the next visit

Keep a record of rainfall and watering days, because this makes it easier for the next volunteer to decide whether the beds need more water.

Additional information for registered garden teams

The newsletter format was chosen because it lets volunteer teams share planting records and explain how their garden changed throughout the season.

The northern beds receive less direct sunlight than the rest of the site. Choose crops that tolerate partial shade, and leave enough space between them to maintain airflow during damp weather.
